conventions.name: package-shell-files
conventions.description: Every RelKit package owns one manifest, TypeScript project, and public entry file.

conventions.name: package-entry-barrel
conventions.description: Package entry files stay pure barrels as package APIs grow.

conventions.name: relkit-area-entry
conventions.description: Every relkit source area keeps one entry file that its subpath export points at.

conventions.name: relkit-graph-without-runtime
conventions.description: The application graph area stays independent of the HTTP runtime and of deployment engines.

conventions.name: relkit-engine-without-local-providers
conventions.description: The engine depends on provider contracts, never on the local provider implementations.
